desc:
SOFT BAKED GOODNESS: Nature Valley Banana Chocolate Chip Soft Baked Bars are a quick and easy breakfast snack, lunch box treat, or for any time you are looking to fuel your family

BREAKFAST BARS: Made with whole grains, real fruit, flaxseeds, and chia seeds for a wholesome start to your day; 19g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

QUALITY INGREDIENTS: No artificial flavors, no artificial colors, and no high fructose corn syrup

GREAT ON THE GO: Hearty-size breakfast bars provide great taste on the go; Toss an individually wrapped bar in a backpack, tote, or school snack bag

CONTAINS: One 8.85 oz box of Nature Valley Banana Chocolate Chip Soft Baked Breakfast Bars
features:
Key Features:

Soft-Baked Muffin-Like Texture

Offers a moist, chewy experience similar to a chocolate chip muffin.

Whole Grain Goodness

Each bar provides 8g of whole grains, supporting healthy digestion and sustained energy.

Chocolate Chip Flavor

Includes real chocolate chips for a sweet and satisfying bite.

No Artificial Additives

Made without artificial flavors, colors, or high-fructose corn syrup.

Individually Wrapped

Convenient single-serve packaging makes it easy to grab and go.

Wholesome Ingredients

Includes nutritious elements like oats and other natural grains.

Benefits:

Perfect On-the-Go Breakfast

Quick and convenient for busy mornings or a fast snack.

Kid- and Family-Friendly

Delicious flavor and soft texture make it appealing to both kids and adults.

Portion Controlled

Helps manage calories and sugar intake while still enjoying a treat.

Great Anytime Snack

Works well as a school snack, lunchbox addition, or post-workout pick-me-up.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Whole Grain Wheat Flour, Sugar, Canola and Palm Oil, Semisweet Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Corn Syrup, Vegetable Glycerin, Banana Puree, Chia Seeds, Flaxseeds, Sugarcane Fiber, Raisin Juice Concentrate, Chicory Root Extract, Baking Soda, Molasses, Salt, Egg Whites, Cinnamon, Natural Flavor, Nonfat Milk.
